[SWS_CM_11111] Processing a method call on the server side (polling)
⌈
In
case a MethodCallProcessingMode of kPoll has been passed to the construc-
tor of the ServiceSkeleton (see [SWS_CM_00130]), the ProcessNextMethod-
Call method is be responsible for calling take() on the DataReader processing
the Request Topic associated with the service (see [SWS_CM_11105]). Process-
NextMethodCall, shall take only the first sample from the DataReader’s cache and
dispatch the call the appropriate service method (see [SWS_CM_00191]) of the Ser-
viceSkeleton class according to the value of the of the discriminator of the <sv-
cId>Method_Call union and provide the destination method with the specific Ar-
gumentDataPrototypes in the union case.
⌋

to the constructor of the ServiceSkeleton (see [SWS_CM_00130]), the Process-
NextMethodCall method is to be implemented as described in [FO_PRS_DDS_-
00312].
